title: podocarpus macrophyllus subsp. forrestii
intro: Podocarpus macrophyllus subsp. forrestii, commonly known as Yew Pine, is a slow-growing, evergreen conifer native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Yew Pine include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Yew Pine include sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
